lines: Tag several agents and people in one message. Every agent you tag answers, even when you tag a person too.
Chats are calmer: results, progress and status show as clean cards, and the session pane marks each hour.
Every menu option does what it says. Files can move folders anywhere and restore them from Trash.
Times read the same everywhere, in your Space's time zone.
One corner style across the app, and menus near the edge line up with the button that opened them.
Calendar syncs are much faster, and Codex failures say plainly what went wrong and when to try again.
